name: Senkawa Kasumi
source: Kasumi owns the ski resort that Minoru and his friends have been visiting for years, so she knows all of them well, since they were little kids in fact. She's usually very cheerful, despite the fact that her favorite pastime involves horrifying her guests with scary stories.
